packageRules.description: typescript must stay below v7: TypeScript 7 ships no compiler JS API, so typescript-eslint 8.x hard-fails on it (TS >= 7.1 support tracked in typescript-eslint#10940). The runtime is bun and unaffected; only lint and the editor care. tsconfig.json also needs moduleResolution/module rework before TS7.
All minor and patch updates share one automerged PR; majors stay separate via the rule below.
Track paperless-ngx pre-releases (v3 beta) in their own reviewed PR — not automerged, and a reviewer ping is the notification channel.
Keep major bumps in their own PRs for easier review/rollback. A reviewer ping notifies; the version-locked groups below come after this rule on purpose and re-group their majors.
Group ARC charts together, including majors: controller and runner are versioned jointly and must not drift while one PR waits.
Group authentik server, worker and proxy, including majors: outposts must match the server version exactly or forward auth breaks for every ingress.

Keep both Postgres clusters on the same major.minor, including majors. postgres-winkel runs the tensorchord VectorChord operand image and postgres runs the community one; docs/immich-migration.md 3.1 requires they match, and pg_dump is forward-compatible only.

Own app meals: checked on every run instead of only on the scheduled run, automerged, so a freshly pushed build from the meals repo reaches the cluster in minutes-to-hours. Includes majors on purpose — reverting an own-app bump is trivial.
Own app trip: same fast lane as meals.
